title: Viettel Cyberbot
overview: Chatbot platform serving banking and financial organizations across multiple communication channels with live chat and real-time messaging capabilities.
challenge: Build multi-channel chatbot platform supporting concurrent live chat, real-time messaging, and API calls while maintaining stability under production load across multiple banking clients.
contributions: Architected full-stack chatbot application (Laravel + Vue.js) with CMS-driven configuration system (scenarios, entities, patterns) enabling non-technical staff to manage conversation flows.
Built multi-channel embedding system: iframe, Facebook Messenger WebView with isolated context and request queuing.
Designed Admin Dashboard (Vue.js + Laravel) for analytics, live chat operations, agent workload distribution, and RBAC user management with SSO integration.
Optimized database performance: improved query efficiency through eager loading and indexing, implemented two-tier caching strategy with Redis.
Enhanced real-time messaging: configured Socket.IO and Laravel Echo Server for concurrent connections with graceful degradation.
Improved CI/CD pipelines: GitLab CI multi-stage builds, automated testing, Docker containerization, and coordinated deployments via ArgoCD on Kubernetes.
Set up observability stack: Prometheus for metrics collection, Grafana dashboards for system monitoring and incident debugging.
